sentences.en: I had to use a dirty, smelly gas station bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我只能使用一个又脏又难闻的加油站洗手间。

sentences.en: Take off those smelly socks: they're soaking wet with sweat.
sentences.zh: 脱掉那些难闻的袜子：它们被汗水浸透了。

sentences.en: The only window in our hotel room opens onto a smelly alley.
sentences.zh: 我们酒店房间唯一的窗户正对着一条难闻的小巷。

senses.zh: 发出难闻气味的，有臭味的,〈口〉“smell”的派生
